notes.title: BRING IT DOWN! Version 1.0b
notes.content:
Hello!

We've launched a small patch for BRING IT DOWN! We'd also like to thank our users who helped report some errors with package configuration and it looks like we've been able to get those sorted as well. If you're still running into these issues make sure to reach out to us directly on Discord or the forums.

Patch Notes for 1.0b
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with levels with unattainable challenges
[*] Fixed an issue with material rendering
[/list]

Known Issues for 1.0b
[list]
[*] Some levels can take a long time to load and may freeze the game for a few seconds
[/list]

As always, thanks for playing and we'll have more updates soon.

-Troy

notes.title: BRING IT DOWN! Launches Today!
notes.content:
Hello from MIRROR QUEEN!

We're excited to get our first VR game out the door and into your hands. We really do hope BRING IT DOWN! makes its way onto your list of favorite VR games to show your family and friends. 

Over the next few weeks we'll be directly addressing issues posted on the Steam forums as well as anything we come across on our [url=https://discord.gg/5PU7Knk]Discord[/url] (which is the quickest way to get in contact with us). We've got little improvements here and there to make and some small graphical tweaks that are in the works, but the next big update is coming in late November or early December.

[h1]The Big Update[/h1]

Lots of things haven't made Version 1.0 like we originally were hoping, but this additional time to polish up a few features is much appreciated and we want everyone to be looking forward to what we've got in store for the future. Let's talk about a few, and we'll save a few for later.

[b]Level Editor & Steam Workshop[/b]

As we posted back in June, we've already got the groundwork for a solid level editor. In fact, all of the levels in the game were basically designed in it. We have a working level format and things have progressed nicely in this area since we last talked about it. We want something that will give creators everything they need while making it accessible, and that's kind of tough but we think you'll like what we put together.

And what's a level editor without Steam Workshop? We've worked with the workshop heavily in our past games and have grown to love its features and the wacky things our communities have come up with. We'll have workshop support [b]far beyond any of our past titles[/b] and we hope to foster another great creative community.

[b]New Locations[/b]

Right now the city backdrop is the only thing you see during a game. Obviously the backdrop isn't integral to the gameplay, but right now you could make an argument that the setting is a bit lacking and we'd agree with you. Each level set will have its own location with a semi-unique theme, so look forward to that!

[b]Steam Achievements[/b]

We're putting together a list of achievements that are both fun to get, while not being just painful drag. We want the achievements for this game to mean a bit more to us than the way we've treated achievements in the past, and we'll show you what that looks like in our big update.

[b]Pancake Mode[/b]

When we started working on BRING IT DOWN! I couldn't envision any other way to play it other than VR, and to a certain extent I think that VR will remain the recommended way to play moving forward. Making levels and testing them is much easier done in 2D or "pancake" mode and we think that creators will want to utilize the game and its tools in a similar way to how we have. This has the added benefit of letting people who don't have VR headsets give it a try, even if it isn't quite the full experience.

So while this next big update will upgrade our pancake mode from beta to production we still think you should play in VR, but we're big fans of the option when needed.


Thanks for reading! Enjoy BRING IT DOWN! and we'll talk soon!

-Troy
